Subject: Retainer invoice schedule & PO attached
Attachments: PO_789_Acme.pdf (PDF)

Hi Monica,

Thanks — we've signed the MSA and want to get the annual retainer on your books this month. Please can you confirm the invoicing options and send a formal invoice that our AP desk can pay to hit fiscal cutoffs? Our requirements:

- We need a PO (attached) to be referenced on the invoice.
- For VAT purposes we need the invoice to show the Acme EU VAT ID when applicable and the US billing address for wire instructions.
- Prefer a single upfront invoice if possible, but we can accept quarterly invoicing if that helps cash-flow.
- Please include ledger/account codes so our ERP (NetSuite) maps it to the right GL accounts.

Billing contact: AP Team <ap.payments@acme-eu.com>
Let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
Emily Torres
Finance Operations — Acme Health
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retainer invoice schedule & PO attached

Emily — appreciate the PO. Looping in Marissa (finance) and Rishi (sales ops) so we can land the exact invoice format and ledger mapping. High-level options we recommend: 

1) Single annual invoice (preferred for accounting simplicity): one invoice for the full committed amount, payment due in 30 days. We will provide a monthly statement showing drawdowns against the retainer for your internal reconciliation.
2) Four quarterly invoices (same total, invoiced per tranche): each invoice is due on receipt and tied to the monthly drawdown schedule. Slightly more operational overhead.

To proceed we need:
- Billing address and VAT/Tax ID for the billed entity (for invoice header)
- Confirm which option (1 or 2) you prefer
- Any PO number that must appear exactly as in your ERP (I see PO_789 in the attached file but confirm).

We will prepare a draft invoice and share for sign-off before sending the final.

Thanks — I will aim to have a draft today after Marissa confirms the VAT treatment.

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick finance note. Based on the entity details I see in your PO we will treat this as follows unless you instruct otherwise: 

- If billed to Acme Health Europe (has EU VAT ID), invoice will include VAT line and reverse-charge language where appropriate. If billed to US entity, no EU VAT will be applied.
- For a single upfront invoice we will add a statement line for monthly drawdowns: we will send a monthly usage statement (CSV) that lists consumption + remaining retainer balance. That is the simplest for reconciliation.
- Ledger mapping: use code 6100.41 (Professional Services — Retainer) for NetSuite mapping; please confirm if your AP requires a different GL.
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default. Wire details are in the attached instructions; we can also push the invoice via your Ariba/Concur connector if you prefer.

Action items for Acme from finance: send billed-entity legal name, VAT/Tax ID (if applicable), and confirm PO number exactly as it must appear on the invoice.

Marissa Cole
Senior Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
